global_read: global.json (17:38) shows Brent crashing -7.75% 1d to $83.14 (still +15.5% 1mo) and WTI -6.58% 1d to $79.10 -- a sharp overnight relief in the energy-shock premium that was the dominant risk-off driver last run -- while S&P +0.7% 1d and Dow +0.53% 1d firmed and VIX stayed calm at 16.11 (+0.75% 1d). Gold still bid (+1.46% 1d) suggesting some residual hedging demand, and crypto softened (BTC -1.48%, ETH -2.31%). USD/PKR is little-changed (277.63, +0.46% 1d, -0.04% 1mo) and DXY eased -1.08% over the month -- a broadly constructive external backdrop for PKR today. Net read for PSX: the acute energy/geo-risk shock that justified the prior risk-off call is visibly easing, equities/VIX are calm, but oil is still materially above its 1-month base and Pakistan's external account (reserves, current account) has not yet turned -- treat the tape as improving, not a clean risk-on signal.
drivers: PBS confirmed July 2026 CPI at 9.2% YoY, down sharply from June's 11.1% -- a continued deceleration though Bloomberg and Business Recorder both flag it as partly a base-effect story (July 2025 base was 4.1%) rather than a clean easing of underlying price pressure, with energy-cost risk (daily fuel-price revisions since the Hormuz crisis) still clouding the outlook (https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-03/pakistan-consumer-inflation-cools-as-energy-risks-cloud-outlook, https://www.brecorder.com/news/40432859/pakistan-inflation-clocks-in-at-92-in-july-2026, https://www.app.com.pk/business/headline-inflation-decelerates-to-9-2-percent-in-july/)

favored: banks/fixed-income proxies (T-bill 11.79%/PIB 12.14% 10Y still well above the held 11.5% policy rate; decelerating CPI and a calm SBP hold support the earnings/yield story)
